title: Deep pullbacks
description: Level 1 upswings from 62,706. The pullback from 63,405 came 59% of the way back to 62,989 (4 May 07:00); the pullback from 64,430 came 87% back to 63,164 (5 May 02:00) over sixteen hours, and the upswing was still confirmed by the close above 64,430 after it. The downswings at the end read 46% and 59%. The last pullback, from 65,179, had read 99% when the snippet ends; it is a candidate, so it is not asserted.
